title: Native Windows configure cannot forward an explicit kernel pin and cache through the launcher
body: The required native configure needed a hand-built cmd.exe invocation to call vcvars64, add the project-local Ninja, export WSLENV for Undertow/Yeroket roots, and pass VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE plus VIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR. The launcher should expose a supported native configure path for an explicit pin and isolated cache.

title: Native Windows provisioning did not leave the pinned Ninja toolchain ready for configure
body: The queued native configure could not start until the documented provision step installed the project-local pinned Ninja 1.13.1 into VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain/ninja. Native provisioning should either guarantee the configured toolchain is present before configure or make the missing-tool state explicit and actionable.
